message: Production acceptance test refreshed against EUROPE-EXHAUSTIVE-v2: Germany search now has an explicit mandatory 15-portal discovery baseline plus all broader source layers including BA, EURES, EURAXESS, national public employment, university/research portals, company career sites, ATS platforms, MedTech clusters, specialist recruiters and other reputable job boards/aggregators. Discovery remains recall-first; publication remains strict.
methodology: EUROPE-EXHAUSTIVE-v2: 15 mandatory German portal discovery baseline + all other relevant job boards/aggregators + public employment/EURES + EURAXESS + national sources + official employer/ATS + universities/research institutes + MedTech clusters + broad discovery + strict 0-years adjudication + official verification + vacancy-fingerprint deduplication + persistent rediscovery/reverification + false-negative hunt. The protocol is fixed; daily vacancy results may change.

passed: 15 named German portals explicitly added as mandatory discovery baseline
Broader ATS, employer, public employment, research, university, cluster and other job-board layers retained and explicitly documented
English and local-language search requirement preserved
